title: Hand Devin a month of real coding and research work
summary: The Answer.AI team gave Devin 20 real tasks over a month; they report 14 failures, 3 successes and 3 unclear results, with no way to predict which would work.
agent_role: Devin planned and executed tasks end-to-end in its own environment; humans assigned tasks, reviewed results and in one case abandoned Devin's attempt to rebuild with Cursor step-by-step.
outcome: Out of 20 tasks: 14 failures, 3 successes and 3 inconclusive; authors could not discern a pattern predicting which tasks would work
what_they_did: The Answer.AI team spent a month giving Devin real work through Slack and its website. Tasks included new projects from scratch, research, and changing existing projects. Devin worked in its own space with a browser, a code editor and a command line. The team assigned and reviewed the work, and sometimes rebuilt it themselves in another coding tool, Cursor.
how_it_went: The authors report 14 failures, 3 successes and 3 unclear results out of 20 tasks. An early win was a tool that kept Notion and Google Sheets in step. Later tasks often dragged on for days or ended in overly complicated code, and they found no pattern that predicted success.
worth_knowing: Devin kept going on impossible tasks: asked to host several apps in one Railway setup, which Railway doesn't support, it spent over a day inventing features that didn't exist. The authors say rescuing failed attempts was the biggest cost.
prompt: Before starting, read the docs for [service or API] and tell me whether [task description] is actually possible with it. If it isn't, stop and explain why instead of trying workarounds. If it is, write a short plan with the simplest approach and the files you'll touch, and wait for my approval. Then do it in small steps, keeping the code minimal with no extra layers of abstraction. Show me a working result and a summary of anything you were unsure about. Ask me before you deploy or use any credentials.

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
